description: This file defines the internal class SharedCallbackData used within the Orleans runtime. It manages callback information, including unregistering actions, logging, and cancellation parameters for message handling.

classes.name: SharedCallbackData
classes.description: A class encapsulating callback data for message responses, including timeout management, cancellation, and logging.

methods.name: SharedCallbackData
methods.description: Constructor initializing callback data, including unregister action, logger, response timeout, cancellation flags, and manager.

methods.name: ResponseTimeout
methods.description: Property to get or set the response timeout and update associated stopwatch ticks.
